source.title: Claude design panel 2026-10-20, falsify lens: CONTROL for the open-side FVG leader -- the leader's exact entries with a FIXED 37-point stop and target instead of the middle candle. Its random control used a fixed 37-point stop while the leader's own stop moves with volatility (trades with stops under 25 points lose, trades over 50 points make $237): this asks whether the edge is in the entry (buyers above the open, the faders pay) or only in the volatility-weighted stop.

entry.words: Above the 09:30 open: a limit at the near edge of the most recent 15-minute up fair value gap; below the open: the most recent down gap; gaps at least 0.1 x ATR(14) high. Stop 37 points, target 37 points (1:1). Up to two trades a day.

taught: [chat 2026-10-19] above the 09:30 open: longs on the most recent FVG; below: shorts
[chat 2026-10-19] owner: run the same rule at 1:1
[Claude 2026-10-20, sheet cl_fvg_oside_15_mid_r1_t2_gap0p1] gaps at least 0.1 x ATR(14) high; two a day

[Claude design panel 2026-10-20] CONTROL: the middle-candle stop is REPLACED by a fixed 37 points (the leader's median stop and the size its random control used); the same gaps are traded (a middle candle not beyond the near edge still gives no order)
not_run: THE STOP: 37 points fixed, NOT the middle candle's extreme (the owner's stop): this is a control, not a strategy.
THE CAP: two a day (one instance for the whole window).
SIDE: price vs the 09:30 open is read on each 15-minute close, not tick by tick.
THE ENTRY: a limit at the gap's near edge; a newer gap or a flip of the side moves the order.
WINDOW: entries 09:30-15:00, an unfilled order cancelled at 15:00.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: build days only.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
